samples: This module models permissions as validated `resource:action` text values and roles as named bundles of permissions. It provides helpers to combine permissions across roles, find which required permissions are missing, check whether a set of roles is sufficient, and compute the overlap between two roles. Its `main` function demonstrates the logic with a viewer and editor, printing whether publishing is allowed, any missing permissions, and the permissions they share.

This module models permissions as validated `resource:action` text values and roles as named bundles of permissions. It provides helpers to combine permissions across roles, find which required permissions are missing, test whether a set of roles is sufficient, and compute the overlap between two roles. Its sample `main` checks a viewer/editor pair against publishing requirements, prints whether publishing is allowed, lists any missing permissions, and shows the permissions they share.
